definitions.gloss: generally; commonly; in general; as a rule
definitions.explanation: Used to state what is true in most cases or what most people think or do. A common sentence-level adverb.

examples.japanese: {一般的|いっぱんてき}に{言|い}って、それは{正|ただ}しい。
{日本|にほん}では{一般的|いっぱんてき}に{靴|くつ}を{脱|ぬ}いで{家|いえ}に{入|はい}る。
examples.english: In Japan, people generally take off their shoes before entering a house.

examples.japanese: この{病気|びょうき}は{一般的|いっぱんてき}に{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}に{多|おお}いとされている。
examples.english: This disease is generally considered to be more common in elderly people.

notes:
Adverbial form of {一般的|いっぱんてき} (general, common). One of the most frequently used adverbs for making generalizations in both spoken and written Japanese.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一般的|いっぱんてき}に{言|い}って: generally speaking
- {一般的|いっぱんてき}に{言|い}えば: generally speaking (conditional form)
- {一般的|いっぱんてき}には: in general (with topic marker for emphasis)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {普通|ふつう}: usually, normally (more casual; describes the default state)
- {大抵|たいてい}: usually, mostly (about frequency)
- {概|おおむ}ね: generally, on the whole (more formal)
- たいがい: generally, usually (slightly colloquial)
